seoTitle: Baltimore City Public Schools Calendar 2026–27: Key Dates & PDF
seoDescription: The 2026–27 school year starts August 24, 2026, for most Baltimore City Public Schools students. Check closures, breaks, make-up dates, PDFs, and an ICS download.
heroSummary: Students at most City Schools campuses start school on Monday, August 24, 2026. Some charter schools may follow a different calendar. Winter break runs December 23 through January 3, with classes resuming January 4. Spring break runs March 26 through April 4. The scheduled last day is Friday, June 11; June 14–16 are reserved for inclement weather make-up days.

comparisonTitle: Baltimore City Public Schools Calendar Compared With Nearby Districts
compareIntro: Compare Baltimore City’s first day, scheduled last day, and major breaks with nearby Maryland school districts.

comparisonInsights.label: Start date comparison
items: Baltimore City and Howard County both start on August 24. Prince George’s County starts one day later, on August 25, while Baltimore County starts on August 31.

comparisonInsights.label: Scheduled last day comparison
items: Howard County lists the earliest scheduled last day, June 8. Baltimore City lists June 11, followed by Baltimore County on June 14 and Prince George’s County on June 15.

calendarFaqs.q: Does this Baltimore City calendar apply to charter schools?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar says it applies to most schools. Some charter schools may use a different start date, and individual schools may publish additional dates, so families should check updates from their school or school leader.

calendarFaqs.q: Will the downloaded Baltimore City calendar update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The .ics file is a one-time import for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook. It will not update automatically if Baltimore City Public Schools revises the calendar.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families confirm last-minute Baltimore City calendar changes?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Baltimore City Public Schools calendar page, district announcements, and updates from your school or school leader for final confirmation.

definitions.description: This calendar applies to most City Schools campuses. Some charter schools may use a different start date, and individual schools may publish additional dates.
Students are dismissed four hours after their school's normal start time. Plan for earlier pickup, bus arrival, and after-school care on October 15, October 23, January 15, March 25, and June 11.

Observance days are not automatically days off. The district says first-time testing and field trips should not be scheduled on these dates, and schools should make a reasonable effort to avoid athletic events. Some observances begin the evening before; on the district calendar, this applies to September 12, September 21, February 8, March 10, April 22, April 28, May 17, and June 11.
June 14–16 are reserved as inclement weather recovery days and could extend the school year.
Students are off Wednesday, November 25, through Friday, November 27. The district labels November 26–27 as Thanksgiving Break; November 25 is a districtwide Wellness Day.
